items.headline: Man charged in 2024 South Park kidnapping and rape
items.blurb: A 58-year-old man arrested Oct. 8 was charged Oct. 13 with first-degree kidnapping with sexual motivation and second-degree rape over an alleged November 2024 attack in South Park. The case is pending.

items.headline: Junction smash-and-grab spree: storefronts and a bakery hit
items.blurb: A suspect breached a California Ave SW storefront with a masonry projectile, and a burglar shattered a bakery's front door and tried to pry open its drop-safe, the same day.

items.headline: Two held after package-theft run in North Delridge
items.blurb: Police detained two suspects near SW Barton St and 24th Ave SW who had taken eight packages from five addresses.

items.headline: Gas station clerk shot dead near Belltown
items.blurb: Officers responding to a report of an unresponsive man found a store clerk with gunshot wounds at a gas station in the 300 block of Broad Street. Homicide detectives are investigating.

items.headline: Man stabbed in the head in botched robbery at Woodland Park
items.blurb: A man was stabbed near a picnic shelter around 12:30 a.m. Monday and taken to Harborview with injuries police called not life-threatening. Police believe he knew the suspect; no arrest yet.

items.headline: Alki burglar forces patio door, grabs laptops and jewelry
items.blurb: A residential burglar forced a patio door in the 2800 block of 48th Ave SW and stole laptops, jewelry and camera gear.

items.headline: Catalytic converters sawed off three hybrids in Morgan Junction
items.blurb: Thieves cut converters from three parked hybrids in the 6400 block of California Ave SW.

items.headline: Masked gunman robs Roxbury convenience store
items.blurb: A masked man with a gun robbed a convenience store in the 1500 block of SW Roxbury St and ran off on foot.

items.headline: Drive-by at 4th Ave S nightclub kills security guard, wounds woman
items.blurb: Shortly before 1 a.m. Sunday a driver fired into a nightclub parking lot, killing a 36-year-old security guard and wounding a 27-year-old woman. Police found the suspect's car burned less than an hour later; no arrests yet.

items.headline: 50 shell casings: teen arrested after Kerry Park party shooting
items.blurb: Two men were wounded when gunfire broke out at a late-night street party at Kerry Park. Police arrested a juvenile on assault charges after finding a rifle in a vehicle, and collected 50 casings.

items.headline: Pedestrian killed on 15th Ave NW in pre-dawn Ballard crash
items.blurb: A driver called 911 to say he had hit a pedestrian; medics found the person dead in the northbound lanes of 15th Avenue Northwest.

items.headline: Machete attack at Hing Hay Park: man charged with assault
items.blurb: Prosecutors charged a 44-year-old man with first- and second-degree assault over an Oct. 6 machete attack on two people in the Chinatown-International District park. Bail was set at $500,000.

items.headline: Trafficking unit sweeps Aurora, makes arrests
items.blurb: More than 20 SPD personnel from the Human Trafficking Unit and Community Response Group targeted prostitution solicitation along Aurora Avenue North on Oct. 6.

items.headline: Cyclist robbed at knifepoint on the Delridge trail
items.blurb: Three people robbed a cyclist at knifepoint near the 3800 block of Delridge Way SW.

items.headline: State Patrol 'Most Wanted' fugitive caught in Seattle
items.blurb: A 39-year-old man wanted for vehicular homicide in a February head-on crash on U.S. 101 was arrested in Seattle on Oct. 5.

items.headline: Shots fired in Aurora gas station lot, man hurt
items.blurb: Detectives are investigating a shooting in a gas station parking lot in the 10500 block of Aurora Avenue North; a 44-year-old man had head injuries possibly from broken glass.

items.headline: Shots fired in High Point, parked car hit
items.blurb: Casings were recovered and a parked sedan was damaged after gunfire in the 6500 block of 35th Ave SW. No one was reported hurt.

items.headline: Hit-and-run leaves cyclist critical; police hunt silver Camry
items.blurb: Detectives say the suspect vehicle is a silver 2012–2014 Toyota Camry sedan. The cyclist remains in critical condition.

items.headline: Woman cut, beaten and robbed after getting into car in North Seattle
items.blurb: Police say two men forced a 27-year-old woman out of a car in a parking lot, cut and struck her, took her cash and drove off. The robbery unit is investigating.

items.headline: Box trucks torched at SoDo rental lot
items.blurb: Detectives are investigating an early-morning fire that burned several rental box trucks near the 3400 block of 1st Avenue South.

items.headline: Independent team takes over probe of police-involved death
items.blurb: At SPD's request, the Independent Force Investigative Team – King County is investigating an officer-involved death in South Seattle on Sept. 12.

items.headline: Stranger attack downtown investigated as hate crime
items.blurb: A 36-year-old woman was attacked by a stranger downtown on Sept. 18 and left with permanent injuries that need surgery, police say.
